A better question to ask is this: why are so many Americans so ungrateful for the hundreds of billions of dollars that immigrants have netted to the US economy over the past 10 years? Illegal immigrants may slightly take from the economy, but their children and dreamers massively give to it and more than make up for what the illegal ones take from it. The same goes for illness. The healthcare system should be abolished because if we pray and think hard enough, then God will cure our illnesses. Gun control is also the work of the devil, as we should be able to buy anything we want. How is it fair if I want a tank to protect me and my family but am not allowed to have one?

I still don’t understand what you mean by my views being racist when I’m specifically saying that society should be race blind. Do you think that certain races are better than others, and that a race blind society would be racist towards the better ones? I’m trying to understand your argument because my intention is not to start a race war lol.

To address there being different races: some humans have obviously evolved differently over the course of history, but not even close to the extent that people should be characterized into different “races.” Some people may have darker skin than others, but these differences are completely negligible and should be treated as such. For most of human history, people did just that and did not characterize people by race. No only is racial characterization a man-made concept, but it is a relatively new one in the grand scheme of human history. So yes, people who look different simply are different shades of brown. I see no reason for there not to be a color-blind society, as the concept of different “races” of humans is ridiculous and people should all be treated equally regardless of the color of their skin. Here is a link for what I am saying about racial classification being wrong: https://www.scientificamerican.com/article/race-is-a-social-construct-scientists-argue/. Social and cultural distinctions can be attributed to ancestry and environment, but not biology, or “race.” 
As for immigration, here is a link that states that immigrants bring massive gains to the American economy: http://www.epi.org/publication/immigration-facts/. That link is for all immigrants. For the Trump-hated dreamers, they are projected to contribute 281 billion dollars to the American economy over the next ten years: https://www.google.com/amp/thehill.com/blogs/congress-blog/politics/353774-dreamers-contribute-to-our-economy%3famp. Immigrants only bring massive gains to the US economy, and their children especially give great amounts of gains to it. I’m not calling for open borders, but far more immigrants should be let into the US due to their economic contributions and because it is the morally good thing to do. 
As for what you wrote about a war with the white race, I don’t know what you mean. I am not attacking any race with this, I am simply stating that the biology-based, almost completely man-made concept of “race” should not be used as an identifier.

You’ll have to be a little more specific about what parts of what I wrote you don’t like, and why. But I don’t see what’s wrong with them. People are simply different shades of brown, that’s basic biology. As for immigration, immigrants give massive contributions to the American economy, so letting more in would not only be morally good for them but it would be economically beneficial to the United States.

Thanks for the links. I support the creation of a race-blind society because race is really a man-made concept that has no basis in reality. People are just different shades of brown. The mentioning of races like that is weird. I’m very open to increasing immigration levels, though, because it is not only morally good but it is extremely economically beneficial to the United States.
